messages:
Alex: Short thread to lock owners and tooling follow-ups from last night's paging incident. Need someone to run the PMR sync and capture the on-call handoff gap; also want a concrete plan for converting ACTION lines into tracker tasks.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0410 opened 2026-04-10T03:13:09Z. Symptom: regional p99 latency spike + fallback oscillation. Pager delivered; we observed duplicated deliveries for ~3.8m.

Sam: I'll create the PMR (lean template) and toss a 30m review on the calendar. Will pre-seed sections for timeline, customer-impact, RCA, mitigations, actions, and tooling-wishlist. Prefer 30m focused review + async follow-ups. Link incoming.

Maria: I can lead the ops timeline. Critical: capture the 3.8m pager duplication window and the handoff confusion that followed. We need a short handoff template so the incoming oncall knows what's been tried and what's live.

Jin: I'll own the technical RCA. Initial notes: routing-controller backlog estimator mis-sampled under a burst -> queued sockets surged -> backpressure misfired -> failover thrash while KV-cache warmed. I have flamegraphs and a repro script to attach.

postmortem-bot: PMR template created at https://docs.internal/redwood/pmrs/INC-2026-0410. Tip: include ACTION lines in the exact format: ACTION: @owner YYYY-MM-DD - short description. Tag @postmortem-bot in the doc to auto-scan and post created actions to the incident board.

Patrick: Strong vote for a small automation: postmortem-bot parses ACTION lines and makes draft tasks in infra-tracker, then posts a :create_task: button in Slack for quick approval. Avoid forcing people into the tracker until they confirm.

Tess: Also want a handoff checklist that incident-bot can post into the incident channel when paging starts: what was paged, initial mitigation steps, who is oncall, and quick commands to run. Would cut the duplication window.

Alex: Sam, when you scaffold the doc, include a one-liner "what prevented escalation" and a tools wishlist with three items: scheduler POC, ACTION->ticket button, and live pinned summary. Also add a short customer blurb draft for Support.

Sam: Doc created and seeded. Link posted in the channel. I'll also DM likely participants to suggest times and create the invite if they confirm. POC behavior: postmortem-bot DMs three suggested slots; a reaction picks and bot creates invite.

Maria: ACTION: Maria 2026-04-17 - audit pager rotation config; fix race that allowed overlapping rotas and duplicated deliveries. Add a simple preflight that verifies a single active rota per service.

Tess: ACTION: Tess 2026-04-24 - add an integration test that simulates a synthetic 10x burst to the routing-controller and asserts no fallback oscillation; add an alert rule for duplicated pager deliveries.

Jin: ACTION: Jin 2026-04-15 - add KV-cache warmup step to deploy checklist and emit a cold_hit_ratio metric per node. Uploading flamegraphs and repro script to PMR attachments now.

Patrick: ACTION: Patrick 2026-05-01 - prototype action-tracker flow: parse ACTION lines, create draft tasks with visibility tags, and post approval buttons. Must support [internal]/[public] visibility and redact customer names for public views.

Alex: A couple of narrow tooling asks to capture as separate tracked items:
- postmortem-bot meeting scheduler: when a PMR doc is created, bot suggests candidate times via DM and can create the calendar event when confirmed.
- Slack quick-create button: parse ACTION line, open a prefilled issue modal (owner, due date, visibility). Default due date if omitted: +7d.
- incident pinned summary: incident-bot posts a pinned, auto-updating summary block with p90 map, current mitigations, and recommended next steps.

Sam: I'll build the scheduler POC. MVP: postmortem-bot DMs attendees 3 slots based on free/busy; a reaction selects a slot and the bot makes the event. Minimal permissions required.

Maria: For the quick-create flow, ensure unresolved @mentions are left as placeholders and the modal allows selecting an owner. Also make visibility default to [internal] for customer lists.

Tess: Add a short "handoff template" to the PMR: commands tried, mitigations live, contacting steps, next checks, and last-known good timestamp. Incident-bot should inject this template into the channel during paging.

ops-bot: Reminder: existing automations and webhooks live at /tools/incident-bot/README. Any changes should maintain backwards compatibility or provide a deprecation window.

Jin: Confirmed customer impact numbers: ~3.4% of hosted requests affected, ~12 customers saw elevated errors, 2 had client-visible failures >6m. Will paste exact query results in attachments.

Patrick: Prioritization suggestion: 1) pager rotation race fix (critical), 2) pager-duplication alert + handoff template (high), 3) postmortem-bot scheduler POC (medium), 4) ACTION->ticket quick-create (medium).

Alex: Agree. Sam, reflect that ordering in the PMR under "Recommendations" with owners and proposed timelines. Also prepare a 1-paragraph customer-facing blurb for Support to use.

Sam: Added the recommendations, owners, and the customer blurb draft to the PMR. Moved sensitive customer lists to the internal appendix and marked rows [internal].

Patrick: On the dashboard side, ensure the action-tracker supports a visibility column and redaction rules when syncing items to public dashboards. Also link back to PMR.

Tess: I'll add an alert playbook: if routing-controller overload and pager duplication occur, auto-open PMR, tag senior oncall, and post the handoff template into the channel. Low friction helps early alignment.

Alex: Also want a short retro on the incident-bot itself. ACTION: Alex 2026-05-08 - run incident-bot retro and propose three concrete fixes: scheduling, pinned summary, ACTION->task flow.

postmortem-bot: Scanning PMR for ACTION lines. Detected 5 items. Prepared drafts on infra board: https://infra.internal/actions/INC-2026-0410

Sam: I'll push the draft tasks to the action-tracker as pending approval and keep weekly check-ins until closure. If anyone adds more ACTION lines to the PMR, tag @postmortem-bot so it rescans.

Jin: I'll present the RCA and repro in the live review. Proposed quick fix: adjust backpressure window and add a conservative warmup path for KV-cache during failover.

Maria: After PMR, I'll coordinate a small maintenance deploy to patch the pager-rotation service with a rollback plan. Also will add pre-shift pager-verify to the oncall checklist.

Patrick: I'll scope the UI changes and call out infra API needs; if feasible, plan for a follow-on sprint to deliver the quick-create feature.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Meeting scheduled; please add any remaining ACTION lines to the PMR. If you want the scheduler POC by the meeting, ping me by EOD.

Alex: Thanks all. Let's stay blameless and close the loop quickly. The pager fix is top priority."
